- Copy reference markup exactly: same tags, ids, classes, attributes, aria, copy and order. Class names never change. - Global CSS import order (layout.tsx): tokens, base, layout, about, contact, overlays, profile, works, approvals.
- React attribute traps: write data-reveal="" (never bare data-reveal), data-book="" or data-book="deep", data-split="" etc. Put suppressHydrationWarning on <html>. The only className on <html> is the static next/font variable classes; js, is-loaded, smooth-on and has-pointer are added with document.documentElement.classList only, never from React state.
- SVG icons: <Icon name="i-arrow-right" /> renders <svg class="i"><use href="#i-arrow-right"/></svg> exactly as the reference. The About and Contact page-only sprites (ab-ic-*, ct-i-*) are rendered by those pages; wk-guil by the Approvals hero.

- Server components by default. "use client" only for parts with state, effects or listeners; keep client leaves small. Code split heavy interactive parts with next/dynamic or lazy import where it does not change first paint (booking steps, chat panel body, PureBody videos, globe loop).
- Reduced motion, (pointer:fine) and hover capability are read ONCE at start (useReducedMotion, useFinePointer, useCanHover), exactly like the reference. Every rAF loop, timer, observer and listener is cleaned up on unmount; idle loops stop when settled or off screen (orchestrator decision).

- Page entrances and timing follow map 1941-1955 and the "What each page subscribes to" table (map 2153-2217): hero entrances replay on every show; scroll reveals never replay (revealStore).
- Works and Approvals: heroes and bodies talk through window CustomEvents defined in src/features/works/shared/events.ts (fe-19): WK_FILTER_EVENT 'wk:filter' (detail: filter key), WK_JUMP_EVENT 'wk:jump' (detail: project index) and AP_JUMP_EVENT 'wk:ap-jump' (detail: certificate index). Files:

Scroll down the page in viewport steps to trigger lazy images and observers, return to the top, wait --wait ms, apply --hover and --click in order (wait 400ms after each), then take a full page screenshot or, with --selector, an element screenshot of the first match (fail clearly if it is missing on either side).

- tests/visual/visual.ts: the CLI (npm run visual -- ...).
